responsibility: Declares the helper that resolves one HIR enum item into its TyTy::VariantDef representation. The class encapsulates the per-variant handling for plain, tuple, struct, and discriminant-bearing enum variants and is used by higher-level item/type passes that build complete enum ADTs.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TypeCheckEnumItem helper and its visit/Resolve entry points for enum variants, but does not implement variant construction or discriminant/type-checking behavior. The corresponding rust-hir-type-check-enumitem.cc provides that concrete logic.
